I asked to come back for a bite correction at 12 PM the next day. I arrived on time, but the doctor had just gone out for lunch?! Why make an appointment if you can't? The staff at the counter asked if I could wait until almost 1 PM??? I was annoyed at having to come back again, so I just reluctantly waited. In short, I don't know if it's just my bad luck, as other reviews are good, but I won't be coming back here again unless absolutely necessary.😞
